name: Golden Rose (Gold)
description: Rose, a plant in the Rosaceae family, has thorns on its branches and extremely delicate and fragrant flowers. It is often given the meaning of love. In Greek mythology, it is the embodiment of love and beauty. Roses symbolize romance, and couples often express their feelings by giving roses. Different colors and numbers of roses represent different meanings. Golden roses represent nobility, holiness, and cherish blessings, while the flower language of a single rose is "love only one person in your life." Present golden roses to your loved ones and let the flowers convey all your love and affection.
